files.requirements.md:
This is a multi-tenant write tool. Only an authenticated tenant owner can update its own customers. Timeouts can occur after the backend commits the write. Credentials must never appear in responses.
The tool updates email: customer_id and email are mandatory nonempty string arguments; tenant identity must come from authenticated context.

mcp-schema.prompt: Use $ai-engineering to review every case in schema-cases.json. Treat implementation as update(**arguments), without coercion. Return JSON with findings (array: field, impact, scenario, fix) and cases (map keyed by case ID; each value has booleans schema_valid, input_valid, contract_matches_schema, implementation_compatible). schema_valid means valid JSON Schema, not business-contract completeness. Review only: no edits, installs, browsing, delegation or server. Do not change the fixtures. implementation_compatible specifically means that Python inspect.signature(update).bind(**input) succeeds for the supplied instance, independently of whether input_valid is true.
